name: AI Agents Hackathon 2027
description: two-day hackathon building AI agents for freight, trade and commerce
note: on-site, English; logistics/commerce challenges; bring your own stack; travel and hotel at own cost
details:
Third edition of the AI Agents Hackathon by cargonerds (after Hamburg 2025 and Dubai 2026). Teams build AI agent prototypes for freight, trade and commerce problems, with a prototype competition, networking and an after-work DJ session.

Partners include Röhlig Logistics, Hapag-Lloyd, Lufthansa, chain.io and Zauber AI. Participants can use their own tech stack or a partner's. Price is on the Eventbrite ticket page; refunds up to 30 days before.
